traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Eriophyllum (p. 224): leaves essentially alternate.

traits.phyllary_series.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Eriophyllum (p. 224): phyllaries in 1 series, firm, keeled.

traits.receptacle.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Eriophyllum (p. 224): receptacle naked (a few papery scales in one species).

traits.disc_colour.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Eriophyllum (p. 224): disc florets yellow. Word: yellow.

traits.pappus.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Eriophyllum (p. 224): pappus of papery nerveless scales (paleae), rarely none.
